title: Dominic and the Harbor
author: Isandro Joubert
blurb: Edmund Ashgrove, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
